sections.title: Understanding Pairs of Linear Equations

sections.title: Solving Graphically: Step-by-Step Examples
learning_goals: Plot linear equations on a Cartesian plane.

sections.title: Algebraic Solution: The Substitution Method
learning_goals: Understand the steps involved in the substitution method.

Apply the substitution method to solve word problems.

learning_goals: Recall definitions of linear equations and their general form.

learning_goals: Consolidate understanding of both graphical and algebraic methods for solving linear equations.
